story.challenge: Losing clients to competitors with better online booking. Manual scheduling was slow and error-prone.
story.solution: A custom site with real-time booking sync, automated reminders and Square POS integration.
story.impact: Online bookings up 145% within three months, 8 hours saved per week, admin time down 70%, 4.9/5 customer satisfaction.

testimonial.text: Elan transformed our entire digital presence. The integrated booking system alone has saved us countless hours and our online bookings increased by 145%. Absolutely phenomenal work!
testimonial.author: Ilanit Sholomov
